transcript: Speaker A: इतनी रात क्या कर रही हो? [What are you doing so late at night?] Speaker B: I sleep. 'I am sleeping' बोलना चाहिए। [You should say 'I am sleeping'.] Speaker A: I am sleeping. Speaker B: थोड़ा फॉर्मल में 'I am getting some sleep' भी बोल सकते हैं। [In a slightly formal way, you can also say 'I am getting some sleep'.] Speaker A: ओहो अच्छा, English कैसे सीखें? [Oh, I see. How to learn English?] Speaker B: मेरे साथ हर रोज़ बस 15 minute daily practice करने से काफी है। एक महीने में ही अपनी English फर्राटेदार कर सकते हो। [Just 15 minutes of daily practice with me is enough. You can make your English fluent in just one month.] Speaker A: तो महंगा होगा ना? [So it must be expensive, right?] Speaker B: सिर्फ 1 rupay में 3 din इस app को पूरा try करके देख सकते हो। लाखों लोग मेरे साथ daily English सीख रहे हैं। [You can try this app fully for 3 days for just 1 rupee. Lakhs of people are learning English daily with me.] Speaker A: Superb. कैसे join करें? [Superb. How to join?] Speaker B: अभी English Seekho app डाउनलोड करके English सीखना शुरू करो। Experts के छोटे 2-5 minute के videos से सीखो और मेरे साथ जब चाहो practice करो। 24 घंटे available हूँ। मैं promise करती हूँ तुम्हारा कभी मज़ाक नहीं उड़ाऊँगी। सच में। [Download the English Seekho app now and start learning English. Learn from experts' short 2-5 minute videos and practice with me whenever you want. I am available 24 hours. I promise I will never make fun of you. Really.] Speaker A: अभी डाउनलोड करती हूँ। फिर हम लोग वहाँ chat करते हैं। [I'll download it right now. Then we can chat there.] Speaker B: तो install button पर क्लिक करो और English Seekho app डाउनलोड करो। [So click on the install button and download the English Seekho app.] Voiceover: Install Now पर क्लिक करो और अभी English Seekho ऐप डाउनलोड करो। [Click on Install Now and download the English Seekho app now.]

summary: An AI robot avatar corrects a sleeping woman's English grammar in a split-screen format. The AI explains that users can practice English for 15 minutes daily on the English Seekho app to become fluent in a month. The ad promotes a 3-day trial for 1 rupee and encourages viewers to download the app to practice with the AI 24/7 without fear of judgment.
